protocol.sourceSnapshot: one failed source per triplet; exact bytes copied to three distinct PVCs
protocol.bindingOverride: generated recovery manifest is preserved; only claimName and generated name are overridden for isolation
protocol.oracle: native task assertions plus external SHA-256 over actual Workspace bytes and Tekton status
protocol.timing: not a timing benchmark; status polling every 1 second
protocol.authoring: fixtures, policies, and assertions authored with the prototype; no independent author study
protocol.retryWithDirection: earlier or parallel tasks only, checked transitively for each policy root
protocol.staleBuildSelection: operator selects prepare; failed gate declares retryWith [prepare, build]
